name: kanbanflow-mcp-server
description: MCP server for KanbanFlow - manage boards, tasks, and workflows. Fork adds groupingDate support to create-task/update-task.
long_description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for KanbanFlow - manage boards, tasks, and workflows from Claude. This is a local fork of William Holmberg's kanbanflow-mcp-server (MIT licensed) with one addition: the create-task and update-task tools now accept an optional groupingDate parameter (YYYY-MM-DD, or null/empty string for unknown date), matching KanbanFlow's own Create Task API. This only has a visible effect on columns configured as 'date grouped' in KanbanFlow.
